item.title: Introducing Nimbus-7B, an open-weight reasoning model
item.description: We are releasing Nimbus-7B, an open-weight language model for reasoning tasks. Weights are on our GitHub repo together with a reproducible benchmark eval; pip install nimbus-run runs inference locally.

item.title: Our agent SDK now speaks MCP
item.description: The new SDK release adds MCP tool use for agents, with code samples and a CLI for local testing. Available today via pip install.
